items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: We also had great baseball, because we had Schoolboy Rowe and Robin, the pitcher?

ctx.x: Marion Motley and Paul Brown was the coach. That was the first I heard of him. I didn’t hear of him while he was at Massillon, Ohio. But I heard of him when he was coaching up there.
We also had great baseball, because we had Schoolboy Rowe and Robin, the pitcher?
